blocks.h2: Tips Before Buying a New Faucet
blocks.body: Count the holes in your sink or countertop before shopping. A one-hole faucet can cover three holes with a deck plate, but not the other way around. Check the spread on bathroom faucets, usually 4 or 8 inches. Look for a brand that sells replacement cartridges, so a future drip is a simple repair. And if your shutoff valves are original to the house, plan to replace them at the same time. We can do it all in one visit.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of Faucet Work
blocks.body: A cartridge replacement is quick. A new faucet takes longer if the old one is corroded in place or the shutoffs need replacing. Kitchen faucets with sprayers or filters add a few steps. We check first and give you one flat price.

blocks.h2: Faucet Questions From Hanover Park Homeowners

items.q: Should I repair or replace my faucet?
items.preview: If parts are available, repair is often cheaper.
items.answer: If it's a quality faucet with parts available, repair. If it's worn out, replace it.

items.q: Can you install a faucet I bought?
items.answer: Yes, if it's complete and fits the sink.

items.q: Why is my faucet's flow weak?
items.answer: Usually debris or scale in the aerator.
If they're original or stiff, yes.

items.q: Can you fix a pull-down faucet that won't retract?
items.answer: Usually. The weight on the hose may have slipped, or the hose is catching under the sink.

items.q: Can you replace a bathroom vanity faucet?
items.answer: Yes, including the drain assembly if needed.

items.q: How much does faucet repair cost in Hanover Park?
items.preview: It depends on the faucet. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the faucet and what's wrong. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
